role: CI gate: every CoreMotion handler closure passed to start*/query* APIs, and every HealthKit completion passed to beginCollection/endCollection/finishWorkout/enable- and disableBackgroundDelivery, must be queue-delivered (`to:` on the CoreMotion queue APIs) or start with `@Sendable`, preventing main-actor isolation SIGTRAPs on framework threads.
toplevel: cd to repo root. Roots = args or Emuqu and 'EmuquWatch Watch App'; exit 2 if no Swift file found. Python strips // comments (string-aware), finds `.startRelativeAltitudeUpdates(` etc., `.startUpdates(`/`.queryPedometerData(` and the HealthKit names; finds the parenthesis closing the call by depth (within 2000 chars; unclosed -> skipped); the handler is a trailing `{` right after it, else the first `{` inside the arguments; a call with neither (the async HealthKit forms) is skipped; queue APIs with `to:` in the arguments before the closure -> ok; body starting `@Sendable` -> ok; else violation (exit 1). Wired: gates.yml 'Source hygiene guards' (make coremotion-isolation-guard, push and pull_request), ci.yml and Makefile.
